svg.text: prescoach-dev-kiro | Step Functions Standard Workflow | 10 Lambda Functions
Happy Path Flow (Audio File, Embeddings Enabled)
1. SQS message → EventBridge Pipe → Step Functions execution starts
2. LoadConfig (SSM, 10 params) → ParseMessage → UpdateStatus (DDB: Processing) → ValidateFormat → "embed" decision
3. TranscribeAudio (Amazon Transcribe) → CheckEmbeddingsEnabled → ChunkAudio (pydub/ffmpeg, S3) → CreateEmbeddings (Nova Bedrock per chunk)
4. StoreVectors (S3 JSON) → PublishHandoff (FIFO SQS + trigger eval launcher) → UpdateStatus (DDB: Completed)
